verses.gurmukhi: ਤਰਵਰੁ ਗਿਰੇ ਪਾਤ ਬਹੁਰੋ ਨ ਜੋਰੇ ਜਾਤ ਐਸੋ ਤਾਤ ਮਾਤ ਸੁਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੋ ॥
verses.translit_en: taravar gire paat bahuro na jore jaat aaiso taat maat sut bhraat moh maiaa ko ||

en.bdb: Leaves broken from the branches of a tree cannot be re-attached; Similarly, father, mother, son and brother are relations that, like the leaves of a tree, will not stand by you in the end. Such attachments are the dragonet of maya.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਬੁਦਬੁਦਾ ਓਰਾ ਪੇਖਤ ਬਿਲਾਇ ਜਾਇ ਐਸੋ ਜਾਨਿ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਭਰੋਸੋ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise budhabudhaa oraa pekhat bilai jai aaiso jaan tiaagahu bharoso bhram kaiaa ko ||

en.bdb: Just as a bubble of water and a hail perishes in no time, similarly, give up the belief and illusion that this body will stay for long or forever.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਕੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਰਿ ਬੂਝਤ ਨ ਬਾਰ ਲਾਗੈ  ਐਸੋ ਆਵਾ ਔਧਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਨੇਹੁ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਛਾਇਆ ਕੋ ॥
verses.translit_en: tiran kee agan jar boojhat na baar laagai  aaiso aavaa aauadh jaise neh dhrum chhaiaa ko ||

en.bdb: The fire of hay takes no time to extinguish, and just as developing attachment with the shade of a tree is futile, so is the period of our life. Loving it is worthless.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜੀਵਨ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲ ਕੇ ਸੰਗਾਤੀ ਰਾਚਹੁ  ਸਫਲ ਅਉਸਰ ਜਗ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਤਉ ਆਇਆ ਕੋ ॥੫੯੨॥
verses.translit_en: janam jeevan a(n)t kaal ke sa(n)gaatee raachahu  safal aausar jag tab hee tau aaiaa ko ||592||

en.bdb: Therefore, absorb yourself in the Naam of the True Lord throughout your life-span since this is the only asset that will go with you and is the companion for ever. Only then should you consider your birth in this world a success.
